title: Low-Resource Preference Adaptation of LLMs via Activation-Based Label Propagation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adapting large language models to user-specific preferences is often constrained by the cost of human annotation, making preference optimisation impractical in low-resource settings where preferences cannot be reliably labelled by LLMs themselves, e.g., due to cultural, subjective, or personalised contexts. In this paper, we investigate how language models encode preference information in their intermediate representations, finding that activations from chosen and rejected responses form distinct clusters across layers, even in pretrained models. Strikingly, this structure is strengthened by alignment on canonical datasets but erased when the target preferences differ from those the model was aligned on, suggesting aligned LLMs are poor judges for non-mainstream populations. translated_title: 基于激活的标签传播实现大语言模型的低资源偏好适配
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型适配到用户特定偏好通常受到人工标注成本的制约，使得偏好优化在低资源场景下难以实施——在这些场景中，偏好无法被大语言模型自身可靠地标注，例如由于文化、主观或个性化等因素。在本文中，我们研究了语言模型如何在其中间表示中编码偏好信息，发现来自被选择和被拒绝响应的激活在各层中形成明显的聚类，即使在预训练模型中也存在这一现象。令人惊讶的是，这一结构在对规范数据集进行对齐后会被强化，但当目标偏好与模型已对齐的偏好不同时则会被抹去，这表明经过对齐的大语言模型对于非主流群体而言是糟糕的评判者。利用这一结构，我们提出在少量标注偏好对（≤500个）上训练一个轻量级线性探针，并用它来为大量未标注数据进行标注（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型的内部激活中天然存在可区分偏好信息的聚类结构，据此提出仅用少量（≤500个）标注偏好对训练轻量级线性探针来自动标注大规模未标注数据，从而实现低资源场景下的用户偏好适配。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that LLM activations naturally form distinct clusters encoding preference information, and proposes training a lightweight linear probe on as few as 500 labeled preference pairs to auto-annotate large unlabeled datasets, enabling low-resource preference adaptation of LLMs.
